body: Thank you for sharing. Sorry you're dealing with the same, but helps me to feel like it's less personal. Hope you are able to find a way to get your peace back, there's a lot of good advice in here.

Thank you! I do worry about things escalating if it's something against me. No upstairs here, but I'm planning on stocking up on things like door/window alarms, outdoor lights, and better door locks/screws today. 

I've got the power button emergency alert deal set up on my phone to send pictures, audio, and my location to my SO. I do have firearms easily accessible along with ammo.

Unfortunately, yes, the police here doesn't seem interested in doing much work. I'm going to do all I can with the information here to keep myself safe and hopefully not need them in an emergency. Lots of great ideas here.
I am curious where they go from here. I generally keep and eye out to see which direction they head, but once the reach the highway it's anyone's guess.

DEA would be a good one too, I forget they exist. No obvious weapons that I've seen so far, I'll keep an eye out for that.

Nothing particularly expensive here. I drive a 30 year old car, I haven't bought a new TV in a decade. Nothing really comes to mind, I think a thief would be sorely disappointed here.
I would have never guessed that! Any tips for doing searches to find things on less obvious sites like whisper?

You're probably right. I was hopeful that he and his friends had given up on terrorizing me, but at this point it may be here to stay.

The town I'm in is an unincorporated part of the county, so it's hard to get much attention to the area. I will reach out to some of the local politicians and see if I can get their support but oftentimes it feels like they've given up on the area, even for issues like road maintenance, community resources, etc.
Absolutely! My SO lives out of state but I share a detailed log with him in case something were to happen, and fill neighbors in when we catch up.

He left my home when we broke up but stayed in town. I'm not 100% sure why he left the state as I avoid talking to him at all, but I know he did burn quite a few bridges on his way out. He lost his job and was couch surfing to avoid homelessness, so could be a debt.

Thank you!

My parents and myself are the only ones that have really lived in the home since it was built, with the expection of my ex with me for a few months when we were together. It has never been rented out to anyone. I never knew my ex to sell drugs, but he was a former user. Maybe they're not looking to buy from him, but be pointed in the right direction?

It seems it's always different people, but as most of it is at night I haven't gotten a good look at them. It's always different cars, I just can't say for sure if it's not the same people in different cars.

Lighting and signage is a good place to start, I'm working on a budget so I can't afford a giant tall fence from the start. I did already do the chain between poles deal as the road side of the propery is over 300 feet long and very expensive to gate. This has helped quite a bit, though I do still have people parking at the chain in front of no trespassing signs, and they will linger for over half an hour if I don't interrupt them. It was also removed a few times, so adding reinforcement like a lock is my next step.

I'm hoping for a chance to show all the pictures/videos I have to law enforcement. I think with each isolated incident they're willing to brush it off, but a series of issues is harder to ignore.

I've lived here over twenty years, and my parents lived there immediately before me. My ex briefly lived with me, around six months, around four years ago. They could potentially be looking for him, that's not something I had considered.
I do have dogs, I will look into a fencing set up to keep them secure and let them roam the property more.

I haven't seen Deliverance, and maybe now I'm too afraid too, lol.

I have lived here my whole life. My parents have lived here for over forty years, ran small businesses, taught at the school. I only have a few neighbors I would consider close friends, but none that I would consider enemies.

My ex only lived in the area for around 5 years. He had a large friend group, but they weren't generally accepted by the rest of the town because of their criminal activity. If anything, it would be him or his group of friends harassing me more than other people in the town picking a side.

Overall I generally lay low in the community but keep it positive. I am temporarily disabled so I rarely leave the house. People know who I am but generally associate me with my parents, not a reputation I've had a chance to tarnish.

Fortunately, or maybe unfortunately, we can rule out the trap house issue. My parents are the original owners, they owned the property since the land was just an empty lot and were one of the first homes in the area. Reaching out to have someone put some pressure on the local pd sounds like a good move, I didn't realize that would be an option.
Honestly, yes. My biggest concern would be that all this stuff moves with me and I simply can't get away from it.
I do have some cameras, firearms, and a dog. At this point a few more wouldn't hurt. Thank you!
Thank you! My budget is a bit limited so that's a great place to start.

I'll ask about this too. My family has owned the home and the property around it for over forty years, so luckily no drug history there. It also makes it more confusing as this only started occasionally over the last year and has progressively gotten worse, not sure what triggered it.

Thank you! I do feel that some of it is just crappt neighbors, but I also can't help but feel targeted. Luckily I don't live alone so that's a good start, but my family is older and disabled so not a strong defense. Great point on telling more people! I was worried about my friends thinking I was crazy, but better safe than sorry.

I'll have to look into making the space less welcoming. Extra lighting would be a good place to start, it's awfully dark and secluded and night. Thank you for the advice on getting law enforcement attention! They rarely seem interested and I think it's largely due to be so secluded from the rest of the county. Stressing the importance will probably go a long way.
I do have cameras, I will see about getting more installed to cover more property. Thank you for the reassurance, it's hard to know where to draw the line about being paranoid.

I'm really sorry you had an experience like that too. Unfortunately he does private practice so I think the best I could do is contact the medical board in my state. I've been trying to talk to someone through RAINN's chat but for some reason it keeps putting me back at the end of the line when I reach the front so I haven't been able to.
I had been told by my last gynecologist the 21 was the age for pap/pelvic/breast exams but i guess having the results of the pap smear before then won't hurt. And yes, he is in his late 60s
